takes.title: Mime a Monkey with High Reaches and Low Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both arms, opens them to the sides, and repeatedly dips and reaches. They finish upright after lowering the arms.

takes.title: Mime a Bear with Low Bends and Long Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds forward into staggered stances, reaches outward while low, then straightens and steps to finish.

takes.title: Mime a Penguin with Short Steps and Open Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes several open-hand gestures and takes short steps with the arms low, finishing side-on with flexed knees.

takes.title: Mime a Pterosaur with Wide Arms and Deep Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer spreads the arms wide, alternates lower bent-knee positions and high knee lifts, and keeps an arm extended in the closing pose.

takes.title: Mime a Pterosaur with a Low Crouch and Wide Reach
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with one knee high and arms out, sinks into several low crouches, and rises with a diagonal reach before returning upright.

takes.title: Alternate Wing-Like Arm Openings and Bent-Knee Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises and spreads both arms, repeats broad openings with bent knees and turns, then lowers the arms while stepping. The CMU source identifies a pterosaur mime.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Close Hand Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the hands close, alternates small outward gestures and brief knee bends, and ends upright with elbows bent.

takes.title: Mime a Roadrunner with Repeated Forward Leans
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, leans forward with the elbows pulled back, and repeats quick steps and turns before straightening.

takes.title: Mime a Praying Mantis with Wide Elbows and Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates broad arm openings with angular bent elbows and low dips, then returns to an upright side-facing stance.

takes.title: Mime a Ghost with Floating Arm Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, alternates diagonal reaches with bent-knee turns, and raises both hands before lowering them at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Penguin with Small Shuffling Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes small, narrow steps while keeping the arms low, slowly changes heading, and finishes standing in profile.

takes.title: Mime a Dragon with Wing-Like Reaches and Side Steps
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer repeatedly opens both arms and steps sideways, then lowers them and settles upright.

takes.title: Mime a Dragon with Arms Out and a High Knee Lift
takes.actionDescription: The performer extends both arms, turns, raises a knee and brings the arms overhead before lowering them and standing.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Deep Side Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends forward and sideways with alternating high and low reaches, then returns upright after a final side lean.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Small Steps and Open Palms
takes.actionDescription: The performer makes small hand gestures while stepping and bending the knees, opens both hands wide, and returns to an upright stance.

takes.title: Pose with One Arm Raised and Change Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps and reaches one arm diagonally upward, returns to hands at the hips, and later points sideways. The CMU source identifies a superhero mime.

takes.title: Mime a Squirrel with Short Hops and Close Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates compact arm positions and small side steps with brief dips, then finishes with the torso leaning slightly forward.

takes.title: Mime a Squirrel with Repeated Low Crouches
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps with hands gathered, lifts a hand near the face, then repeats deep bent-knee poses before rising.

takes.title: Mime a Squirrel with Angular Steps and Arm Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, moves through angular bent-knee steps and forward hand reaches, then straightens after lifting a hand near the face.

takes.title: Follow a Walking Route with Frequent Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks continuously, changes heading several times, and briefly shortens the stride while turning. The CMU source identifies obstacles in the route.

takes.title: Walk Around Obstacles with Short Reorientation Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates fuller walking strides and shorter turns, changing direction repeatedly before ending mid-step.

takes.title: Walk a Short Obstacle Route and Turn Sideways
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks with the arms low, makes several small direction changes, and continues stepping in profile at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with High Gestures and a Deep Side Fold
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates hands near the head and outward arm sweeps, drops into a deep side fold, then rises with both hands lifted.

takes.title: Mime a Hummingbird with Open Arms and Light Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer spreads both hands to the sides, changes direction with bent knees and small steps, then lowers the arms and steps out.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Deep Forward Bobs
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly bends the knees and tips the torso forward with both arms swept back. They straighten and finish with hands near the torso.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Elbow Lifts and Short Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds both elbows out, repeats short steps and knee bends, and lowers the arms while turning into profile.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Repeated Waist Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates upright resets with deep forward folds while keeping the elbows bent. They return upright in profile.
